goal: Create docs/en/local-executor.md and docs/pt-br/local-executor.md as a practical bilingual operations guide for the implemented local executor. Inspect the actual CLI and code. Include source-checkout usage, dependency setup, --kit-root/--state-dir, validate/run/status/resume examples, required task fields, SQLite/worktree evidence, snapshots of uncommitted inputs, role boundaries, actual configured limits, existing_chatgpt_account policy, explicit native profile loading, failure categories and recovery limitations. Distinguish implemented behavior from future PR/deploy/plugins/meetings. Use a fictional sample task with clearly labeled placeholders; do not imply API keys or paid API provisioning are required. Document the example task as a real local record with no remote GitHub issue. Run checks if useful. Do not modify anything except the two guide files.
acceptance_criteria: Both guides explain the actual implemented CLI with valid command names and directory flags.
Both guides explain task configuration, bounded account-based execution, role results and authoritative checks.
Both guides describe isolation, evidence invalidation, interruption handling and currently pending integrations accurately.
Documentation follows separate English and Portuguese directories, linking its counterpart.

policy.authorization_reference: User request on 2026-10-04: implement the executor and validate agents on real tasks.
